page_topic_one_liner: Breadcrumb navigation — location-based trails, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema, HTML semantics, and Search Console validation
differentiator_vs_generic: This is site-structure breadcrumb implementation, NOT site navigation mega-menus. Hero must show a visible breadcrumb trail on a webpage (Home > Category > Page) paired with a BreadcrumbList schema snippet — NOT an LLM chat panel or generic folder icons alone.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Webpage header zone with prominent location-based breadcrumb trail — Home > Blog > SEO > Current Page — chevron separators, last crumb non-linked with accent underline on prior links; faint page title block below
Secondary: torn-paper JSON-LD code card showing BreadcrumbList itemListElement structure with position numbers 1-2-3 (blurred URLs, schema braces visible)
Tertiary: Rich Results Test pass badge silhouette + small SERP snippet row where breadcrumb path appears inline under a blue title link (generic, no Google logo)
anti_patterns: Generic folder tree without visible breadcrumb trail on a page
Path-based browsing history UI unrelated to hierarchy

en.headline: BREADCRUMBS GUIDE
en.subtitle: Navigation & BreadcrumbList Schema
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for breadcrumb SEO guide. HERO: webpage mockup occupying right two-thirds with location-based breadcrumb trail prominently below nav bar — Home > Blog > SEO > Page, chevron separators, accent alignify-navy on link crumbs, current page plain text. Secondary: BreadcrumbList JSON-LD card with itemListElement positions. Tertiary: generic SERP result row showing inline breadcrumb path under title. Title top-left only. Paper torn edges, halftone. NO LLM chat UI, NO real Google logo, NO readable page URLs as labels, NO WordPress/plugin logos.
